Gideon, you first reported it at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. That's the time Slack shows, and it doesn't name a time zone.

For the guard, your 10:42 message says he was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard because both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Nothing later in the channel describes him doing anything else until kiosk 1 came back. At 11:03 Mateo posted that the guard had checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes had been working since 11:07.

The channel doesn't say whether the guard kept the clipboard going until 11:03 or until 11:07. It also doesn't say what he did with the clipboard entries after the kiosks recovered.
